verdict.rationale: SavvyCal workflows run timed actions relative to individual meetings, such as reminders or a 'Send a webhook' step at a set time before or after a booking. These are per-event triggers, not a recurring job schedule. Nothing in the evidence shows cron-like or interval-based scheduling of jobs or workflows independent of bookings, so this is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
